 Cricket-Rahul closes on century as India eat into New Zealand's lead in Wellington
 Saturday, 21 Nov 2026
 | 8:36 AM MYT
 share 
 bookmark 
 FILE PHOTO: Cricket - International Test Match Series - Fourth Test - England v India - Old Trafford Cricket Ground, Manchester, Britain - July 23, 2025 India's KL Rahul in action Action Images via Reuters/Lee Smith/File Photo 
 Nov 21 (Reuters) - KL Rahul ⁠was closing in on a century as India ⁠batted without loss through the first session of the ‌third day of the first test in Wellington on Saturday, reaching lunch on 239-1 having reduced New Zealand's lead to 129 runs.
 • Opener Rahul, ​who resumed on 52 with his ⁠team 159-1, was 93 ⁠not out at the break in a 109-run partnership with Devdutt ⁠Padikkal, ‌who reached the half-century mark for the fourth time in his five tests and was unbeaten ⁠on 53
 • The Basin Reserve pitch offered little ​for the bowlers ‌on a bright, sunny day in the New Zealand ⁠capital.
 • It ​was a stark contrast with Thursday's first two sessions when Jasprit Bumrah and the other Indian seamers exploited a grassy surface ⁠to reduce New Zealand to 70-5.
 • ​Henry Nicholls, who scored 175 not out, and Glenn Phillips (118) had rescued the New Zealand innings with a 216-run stand for ⁠the sixth wicket and the hosts posted a tally of 368
 • New Zealand: Tom Latham (captain), Devon Conway, Henry Nicholls, Rachin Ravindra, Daryl Mitchell, Tom Blundell, Glenn Phillips, Nathan Smith, Kyle ​Jamieson, Matt Henry, Jacob Duffy
 • India: ⁠KL Rahul, Yashasvi Jaiswal, Devdutt Padikkal, Shubman Gill (captain), Rishabh Pant, ​Washington Sundar, Dhruv Jurel, Anshul Kamboj, ‌Akash Deep, Jasprit Bumrah, Prasidh Krishna
 • ​The second and final test starts in Christchurch on Friday
 (Reporting by Nick Mulvenney; Editing by Muralikumar Anantharaman)
